kebab_example: aliyun outboundbot update-system-configs --object-type INSTANCE --object-id 4f9a8e2b-6c1d-4a7e-9b3f-2d5c8a1e7b04 --configs Value=5 Name=callableTime --api-version 2025-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateSystemConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
INSTANCE: instance level.
TENANT: tenant level
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型\
INSTANCE：表示实例级\
TENANT：表示租户级
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The configuration type ID. If ObjectType is set to INSTANCE, this parameter specifies the instance ID. If ObjectType is set to TENANT, this parameter specifies the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型 ID\
ObjectType=INSTANCE 时，表示实例 ID\
ObjectType=TENANT 时，表示租户 ID
parameters.name: object_id

fields.help_en:
The system configuration name. Valid values:
callableTime: the outbound job window.
calleeDailyAttemptLimit: the maximum number of daily calls to a single callee number
fields.help_zh:
系统配置名称\
callableTime：外呼作业窗口\
calleeDailyAttemptLimit：单个被叫号码每日呼叫上限
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The configuration value.

If Name is set to callableTime, a sample Value is [{"beginTime":"09:00:00","endTime":"12:00:00"},{"beginTime":"14:00:00","endTime":"18:00:00"}].

If Name is set to calleeDailyAttemptLimit, the Value is an integer from 1 to 50
fields.help_zh:
配置值\

Name=callableTime时，Value样例为[{\"beginTime\":\"09:00:00\",\"endTime\":\"12:00:00\"},{\"beginTime\":\"14:00:00\",\"endTime\":\"18:00:00\"}]\

Name=calleeDailyAttemptLimit时，Value值为1~50之间的整数
fields.name: value
